topics.heading: 概要: 流暢さと正確さは別の能力
topics.topic: 「こんなに流暢なら、これもできるだろう」という印象だけでは、LLM の能力を見積もれません。「自然に読める出力」と「要求を満たす正しい出力」は別に評価します。流暢さも正確さも、モデル・言語・入力・タスクに依存します。ツール・検証・設計で補う箇所を、実際の失敗から決めます。

topics.heading: 得意と不得意の構造
topics.topic: 以下は評価計画を作るための整理です。学習データの内訳が非公開のモデルでは、得手不得手の原因をデータ量だけで断定できません。「苦手」は不可能という意味でもなく、採用モデルと入力条件で再検証します。

topics.topic: ツールを使うと、計算や照会を専用の処理へ移せます。ただし、ツール・引数・解釈の誤りは残るため、道具を持たせるだけで解決とはしません。例えば Toolformer は、計算機・検索などのツールを使う学習で対象評価の改善を報告していますが、任意の Agent の正確性を保証する結果ではありません。

proposed.settingsContract: Validate object/options strictly; values may remain in React state but frame effective settings are null outside their allowed stages; only emphasis changes for assessmentFocus and all four steps remain visible. No API call, computed recommendation or external model.
proposed.phaseContract: clampPhase and stageForPhase; deterministic pure frame, stable object IDs across reverse/midpoints, fresh nested arrays; no timers, network, randomness or measured numeric fixtures.
stagesContract: S0: One schematic output splits into separate fluency and requirement-accuracy evaluation paths. No grade, score, correct-answer mark or prose response example. Dependency on model/language/input/task is visible.

S1: Default text task already has two distinct unmeasured evaluation fields, task→independent verification connection, trend-not-guarantee and independent-verification-required labels. Six choices correspond exactly to the six source table rows; trend label is explicitly source-table tendency, not current model result. Preserve source caveats: cause cannot be attributed solely to unavailable training data, weak does not mean impossible, and text fluency/strength does not remove meaning-accuracy validation. Do not add new verification examples per row.

S2: All three source mappings stay visible by default: calculation/aggregation→code or calculator; current/niche knowledge→search/RAG; exact operation/state change→API. Distinguish model judgment and deterministic execution. Selection, arguments and result interpretation retain check points; tools do not make the whole Agent correct. No fabricated successful tool result or accuracy gain.

S3: Date/model/method fields are unrecorded placeholders, not fake evaluations. Benchmark and representative real-case contexts are separate, with harness/contamination/saturation cautions from source. Reasoning effort is a quality/latency/cost evaluation axis with no performance curve or best setting. A return path indicates re-evaluation when model/conditions change.

S4: All four source steps appear together: precision, ability to verify, representative difficult real cases, failure cost plus detection/recovery. Optional focus changes only highlighting. 10–20 remains source trial guidance, not a sufficient sample/pass threshold or required test count. Show no automatic deploy/adopt verdict.
proposed.ownership: Article-specific four files from adopted ownership; root owns shared registry, AST/MDX, dispatcher, article manifest, acceptance inputs, structural/browser tests, public kit and records. Article prose/last_updated remains unchanged.
verification: Unit: all5 phases and .49/.50/.51 reversals,6 task choices,4 focuses, setting influence restricted to S1/S4, every unknown remains null, stable object identity, invalid options rejected, fresh arrays cannot mutate later frames.
AST: both enabled/disabled restore original AST; wrap original5H3/11body blocks incltable once; keep original8H3/14body blocks, no display math or Mermaid. Compare exact text/table/link/list order.

Browser: all5READ stops and all5stages, default S1 mandatory conclusions before touching selector, six source-table choices and all unknown results, S2 all3branches plus3checks, S3 context fields, S4 all4steps under each focus; isolated state, reverse/keyboard/modal/playback, six screen profiles, print/noJS/chunk failure and original text.
Independent actual-image/semantic review and F1 current commit/CI/Pages/artifact/public acceptance required after E3 acceptance. This proposal is only preparation.
